entities.summary: Siegfried Taubert was a Nazi, an SS-Obergruppenführer and a General of the Waffen-SS. From 1935 to 1938, Taubert was the chief of staff in Reinhard Heydrich's Sicherheitsdienst in SS headquarters. From 1938 to 1945, he was the Burghauptmann at Wewelsburg castle, which was Heinrich Himmler's SS headquarters and training center for high-ranking SS officers. Taubert died in Kiel in 1946.
